limitations: EDA over complete data informed the feature candidates: exploratory selection bias remains despite operational leakage controls.
No independent final holdout or external experiment.
LO(G)O folds share training cases; fold SD is descriptive, not an independent standard error or significance test.
Omission sensitivity removes scoring contributions only; previously trained predictions are unchanged, so this does not assess retraining influence.
Nominal groups are not confirmed physical replicates; batch/specimen dependencies remain unknown.
5% and 60% are project decision criteria, not mechanical tolerance, clinical threshold, statistical significance or externally validated acceptance standards.
Moment features are deterministic combinations of existing geometry, not new physical measurements; rigidity EI also requires modulus E and validated deformation direction.
Removing dependent columns changes Ridge effective penalization and hypothesis representation; information dependence does not guarantee prediction invariance.
Target cases 3,9,12 and geometry discrepancies remain as documented; preserve source values, no automatic correction.
All test observations must be disclosed in methodology; no fabricated expansion or augmented observations.
